home.notice: Some sources could not be refreshed. Their previous records were retained.

approval.source: User explicitly authorized merging PR #2 into main and proceeding with production verification.
approval.scope: Merge, existing full collection workflow, Cloudflare production verification and final report update.

resolved_findings.problem: A successful initial index could overwrite the complete flag after detail or application failures, leaving status partial with complete true.
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserve initial discovery evidence as inventory_complete and force complete/closure_complete false on any non-ok source outcome.
regression_tests: Failed detail retains previous same-source and other-country postings without absence-based closure.
Cached job content still invokes fresh application verification; denied access yields unverified job and partial, incomplete source.

pre_merge_review.normalization_note: Only interpretation flags were corrected in the two saved partial outcomes. Original checked_at values, job records and source attempts were preserved; no new collection timestamp was invented.

checks: Every enabled source receives exactly one shard assignment.
Merge rejects missing, duplicate, stale or incomplete shard payloads.
A partial/blocked source cannot close absent postings; prior records remain, subject to the existing freshness policy.
Both provincial coverage reports are regenerated by the existing publish job.
No paid service, recurring AI call, or additional production schedule was introduced.

publication.availability_note: No previous record was removed. One Amazon posting missing from a complete API snapshot became unverified under the existing absence policy (first missing snapshot); one older employer-link check became unverified. Two previous unverified records were reverified. These records remain retained and no incomplete-source absence triggered closure.
publication.transient_deployment_note: During initial alias propagation the clean Groningen URL briefly served the previous fallback. The ordinary public URL subsequently loaded correctly without a revalidation query, including after the bot data deployment.

slow_runner_setup.observation: Live GitHub UI showed Install public-page reader completed in 10 minutes. Collection started at 17:56:12 UTC and reported real employer outcomes including Kenonz. No intervention or configuration change was required.

limitations: Employer census remains an initial, non-exhaustive inventory.
A successful workflow means all configured sources were attempted and consolidation/publication succeeded; partial or blocked source inventories remain explicit.
Unverified IKEA candidates and general HR programmes are excluded from verified internship counts.

daily_schedule.note: The existing daily schedule is unchanged. This verification covers a real full production cycle on the merged code; the next scheduled invocation of that code is a future event, not claimed observed.
